content.text: FinBundle Pro is a modern desktop and tablet application for holistic wealth management, liquidity monitoring, tax declaration, and long-term budgeting according to Swiss and international standards.

items: **Structure Tree (Left):** Organize institutions, banks, brokers, nested categories, and individual assets. Can be toggled with a single click to maximize screen space for charts.
**Workspace (Center):** The interactive command center for transaction journals, 15 specialized financial reports, ECharts vector diagrams, and AI dashboards.
**Property Editor (Right):** Direct editing of master data for the active node (currency, exchange rates, ticker symbols, tax and dividend yields) with seamless background auto-save.

content.text: Access the quick cockpit anytime via the floating tab on the right screen border or using the system shortcut **Ctrl + K** (or **Cmd + K**).

items: **Spotlight Search:** Instantly locates any asset, installed plugin, or analytical report in milliseconds.
**Smart Action Guard:** Automatically detects whether an active account is selected in the tree and opens the appropriate booking form.
**Favorites & History:** Displays your most recently edited assets along with their current balance.
**Pinned Add-Ins:** Launches frequently used custom widgets with a single click.

content.text: Tip: Simply press 'Escape' to close the fly-in panel immediately.
FinBundle Pro features a three-step universal import wizard for banking and brokerage files:

items: **CAMT.053 (XML):** Modern Swiss ISO 20022 banking standard. Automatically parses value dates, counterparties, references, and credit/debit indicators.
**MT940 (.sta / .txt):** Classic SWIFT standard. Parses transaction records (:61:) and transaction narrative details (:86:).
**Generic CSV Files:** Flexible column mapping with automatic delimiter detection, header offsets, sign logic (+/-), and combined turnover columns.
**Target Modes:** Choose between 'Single Account' (imports all bookings into an existing asset) or 'Broker / Multi-Asset' (automatically creates individual assets for each traded security/ISIN).

content.text: Duplicate Protection: FinBundle automatically checks date, amount, and booking narrative against existing records so re-importing statements never creates duplicate entries.
The API LiveEditor is the central control hub for all publicly traded assets (stocks, ETFs, funds, crypto).

items: **Data Grid with Inline Editing:** Add ticker symbols (e.g., AAPL.US, NESN.SW) directly within the table.
**Bulk Sync:** Update current End-of-Day (EOD) prices and historical exchange rates in one batch via EODHD or Alpha Vantage.
**Sparkline Trends:** Visualizes 6-month price trajectories in native currency as well as adjusted to your base currency.
**Fundamental Insights:** Displays dividend yield, ex-dividend date, P/E ratio, EPS, 52-week range, and market capitalization.
**Chart Comparisons:** Run relative performance tests (%), absolute price comparisons, and OHLC candlesticks with technical indicators (SMA 50/200, EMA 20).

content.text: FinBundle Pro provides a sandboxed runtime environment for custom analytical views and visual components.

items: **Creation via Copilot:** Describe your desired widget in plain English. The integrated AI generates the complete HTML/JavaScript code automatically.
**FinSPA JavaScript API:** Plugins receive secure, read-only access to portfolio structures, exchange rates, and cashflow logs.
**Export & Import (.finplugin.json):** Share custom plugins with other users or backup your add-in collection as a bundle.
**Vector PDF Export:** Every add-in can generate high-resolution report pages with charts using the native PdfToolkit bridge.

**Full PDF Report (Full Report Orchestrator):** Aggregates all 15 analytical reports in the background into a single consolidated master PDF with a standardized cover page, KPI summaries, and continuous page numbering.
**Vector Chart Capture:** All ECharts and SVG diagrams are rendered with razor-sharp fidelity into the print layout.
**Excel Export (.xlsx):** Generates a formatted workbook with dedicated sheets for portfolio overview, account balances, securities directory, transaction journal, and dividend calendar.
**Asset Allocation:** Breakdown by bank, asset class, and currency exposure including cluster risk measurement (Top 3).
**Wealth Overview:** Consolidated statement of all accounts, portfolios, and real estate assets on a specific date.
**Liquidity Risk:** Compares instantly accessible cash against market liquidity and tied-up retirement capital.
**Historical Development:** Long-term trajectory of total wealth with MoM deltas and all-time high tracking.
**Category Flow:** Compares start and end balances across categories to highlight your primary growth drivers.
**Waterfall Analysis:** Mathematical wealth bridge: Shows exactly how much growth stemmed from your own savings versus market performance.
**Booking Analysis & Cashflow:** Isolates real income from real expenses and calculates the savings rate while excluding neutral transfers.
**Passive Income:** Complete history of dividends, interest, and rental revenue with monthly and yearly breakdowns.
**Top Flow Assets:** Lists the strongest winners and weakest positions for the selected timeframe.
**Dividend Calendar:** 12-month forward dividend forecast with monthly distribution timelines and ex-date tracking.
**Pension & Pillar 3a:** Evaluates 2nd pillar (occupational) and 3rd pillar assets while monitoring your annual deposit room.
**Securities Performance:** Return analysis of your free stock and fund portfolio with time-weighted yields.
**Tax Report:** Key date valuation of assets and debts as of Dec 31 with automated withholding tax (35%) refund calculation.
**Future Projection (Regression):** Mathematical 5-year extrapolation of past saving habits and compound interest leverage.
**Scenarios & FIRE:** Simulates wealth trajectories across planned life events and evaluates progress toward early retirement.
**Pension Fund (2nd Pillar):** Mandatory occupational pension wealth. Tracked as tied, illiquid capital.
**Pillar 3a Savings Account:** Interest-bearing bank account for private tied provision.
**Pillar 3a Fund Portfolio:** Security-based retirement solutions (e.g., VIAC, frankly, Finpension). Supports unit tracking or total value management.
**Deposit Tracker:** Monitors new money paid in during the current calendar year and warns you before exceeding the legal ceiling.

content.text: The Tax Report formats your data for cantonal tax schedules:

items: **Taxable Net Wealth:** Offsets bank balances, securities valuations, and real estate tax values against mortgage liabilities.
**Tax-Exempt Pension Wealth:** Separately identifies Pillar 2 and Pillar 3a as tax-exempt capital during the accumulation phase.
**Income Statement:** Details all dividend and interest cashflows generated throughout the tax year.
**Withholding Tax Refund:** Automatically computes your 35% refund claim against the Federal Tax Administration (FTA / ESTV).

content.text: FinBundle automatically maps your revenue and expenses according to the **50/30/20 allocation model**:

items: **Needs (Target: max. 50%):** Fixed living expenses such as rent, taxes, health insurance, and utilities.
**Wants (Target: max. 30%):** Lifestyle, leisure, dining out, and subscriptions.
**Savings (Target: min. 20%):** Regular savings, investments, loan amortizations, and Pillar 3a contributions.

content.text: Contract Management: Store custom notice periods for subscriptions in the budget editor to track cancellation deadlines proactively.
FinBundle Pro stores all sensitive financial records locally on your device. There is no central server storage and no telemetry tracking.

items: **Plaintext (JSON):** Transparent standard format for fast saving and manual backups.
**Encrypted ZIP (AES-256):** Military-grade encryption standard. The entire project is secured with your private PIN.
**Auto-Save:** All edits are persisted into the browser's local storage to prevent data loss in case of accidental window closing.

content.text: Important Note on PINs: FinBundle never stores your PIN code permanently. If you forget your password for an encrypted ZIP file, your data cannot be recovered.
